    from deerflow.agents.middlewares.workbench_tool_scope_middleware import (
        WorkbenchToolScopeMiddleware,
        workbench_canvas_policy_from_runnable_config,
        workbench_knowledge_enabled_from_runnable_config,
        workbench_requested_artifact_kinds_from_runnable_config,
    )

    middlewares.append(
        WorkbenchToolScopeMiddleware(
            workbench_canvas_policy_from_runnable_config(config),
            workbench_requested_artifact_kinds_from_runnable_config(config),
            workbench_knowledge_enabled_from_runnable_config(config),
        )
    )

# Product Workbench publication, Knowledge, PRD reference, and Canvas tools are parent-run scoped. A
    # subagent must never rediscover them from the inherited global tool group.
    _workbench_parent_run_tool_names = frozenset(
        {
            "workbench_generation_stage_update",
            "workbench_artifact_draft_publish",
            "workbench_prototype_patch_publish",
            "workbench_knowledge_retrieve",
            "read_file",
            "get_visible_screens",
            "get_selected_screens",
            "view_screen",
            "select_screen",
            "quick_edit",
            "duplicate_screen",
            "rename_screen",
            "navigate_canvas",
        }
    )
    tools = [
        tool
        for tool in tools
        if getattr(tool, "name", None) not in _workbench_parent_run_tool_names
    ]

_DEFAULT_LEAD_GRAPH_RECURSION_LIMIT = 100
_WORKBENCH_PRD_LEAD_GRAPH_RECURSION_LIMIT = 200


def _apply_workbench_lead_recursion_limit(
    config: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    trusted_internal_caller: bool,
) -> None:
    normalized_scope = None
    runtime_context = config.get("context")
    if trusted_internal_caller is True and isinstance(runtime_context, Mapping):
        normalized_scope = _normalize_workbench_scope(runtime_context.get("workbench"))
    config["recursion_limit"] = (
        _WORKBENCH_PRD_LEAD_GRAPH_RECURSION_LIMIT
        if normalized_scope is not None
        and normalized_scope.get("requestedArtifactKinds") == ["prd"]
        else _DEFAULT_LEAD_GRAPH_RECURSION_LIMIT
    )
